description: Conservation of AP3D1 residues 1-14 across vertebrate orthologues: identity to human and hydrophobic moment, one representative per species
code:
import requests, math, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

EIS=dict(A=.62,R=-2.53,N=-.78,D=-.90,C=.29,Q=-.85,E=-.74,G=.48,H=-.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
         M=.64,F=1.19,P=.12,S=-.18,T=-.05,W=.81,Y=.26,V=1.08)
def muH(seq, angle=100.):
    seq=[a for a in seq if a in EIS]
    n=len(seq)
    if n < 6: return np.nan
    th=np.deg2rad(np.arange(n)*angle); h=np.array([EIS[a] for a in seq])
    return math.hypot((h*np.cos(th)).sum(),(h*np.sin(th)).sum())/n

q = "(gene:AP3D1) AND taxonomy_id:7742 AND length:[900 TO 1400] AND fragment:false"
r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
                 params={"query": q, "format": "fasta"}, timeout=300)
recs=[]; hdr=None; buf=[]
for line in r.text.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith(">"):
        if hdr: recs.append((hdr,"".join(buf)))
        hdr=line; buf=[]
    elif line.strip(): buf.append(line.strip())
if hdr: recs.append((hdr,"".join(buf)))
print("query status", r.status_code, "| sequences retrieved:", len(recs))

ref="MALKMVKGSIDRMF"
rows=[]
for hdr,s in recs:
    if "GN=AP3D1" not in hdr.upper().replace("GN=AP3D1 ","GN=AP3D1 "): 
        pass
    gn = hdr.split("GN=")[1].split()[0] if "GN=" in hdr else ""
    if gn.upper() != "AP3D1": continue
    org = hdr.split("OS=")[1].split(" OX=")[0] if "OS=" in hdr else "?"
    acc = hdr.split("|")[1] if "|" in hdr else hdr[1:]
    if not s.startswith("M") or len(s) < 900: continue
    n14 = s[:14]
    ident = sum(a==b for a,b in zip(n14,ref))/14.
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc, organism=org, length=len(s), nterm=n14,
                     pct_id=round(100*ident,1), muH14=round(muH(n14),3)))
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
# one representative per species: the longest entry
df = df.sort_values(["organism","length"], ascending=[True,False]).drop_duplicates("organism")
print("species with a full-length AP3D1 N-terminus:", len(df))
print(df.sort_values("pct_id", ascending=False).to_string(index=False))

print("\nidentity of residues 1-14 to human: median %.1f%%, min %.1f%%, max %.1f%%"
      % (df.pct_id.median(), df.pct_id.min(), df.pct_id.max()))
print("fraction of species identical at all 14 positions: %.2f" % df.pct_id.eq(100.0).mean())
print("fraction >= 10/14 identical (71.4%%): %.2f" % df.pct_id.ge(71).mean())
print("muH of residues 1-14: median %.3f, min %.3f, max %.3f"
      % (df.muH14.median(), df.muH14.min(), df.muH14.max()))

# per-position conservation
pos = []
for i in range(14):
    col = [t[i] for t in df.nterm if len(t)==14]
    frac = col.count(ref[i])/len(col)
    pos.append(frac)
    print(f"  pos {i+1:2d} {ref[i]}  conserved in {frac*100:5.1f}% of {len(col)} species")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
bars=ax.bar(range(1,15), [p*100 for p in pos],
            color=["#d62728" if a in "AVLIMFWCY" else "#1f77b4" for a in ref],
            edgecolor="k", linewidth=.5)
ax.set_xticks(range(1,15)); ax.set_xticklabels(list(ref))
ax.set_ylim(0,105); ax.set_ylabel("% of vertebrate species identical to human")
ax.set_xlabel("AP3D1 residue 1-14 (red = apolar, blue = polar/charged)")
ax.set_title("Per-position conservation of the AP3D1 N-terminal helix\nacross %d vertebrate species" % len(df))
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.3)

ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(df.muH14.dropna(), bins=18, color="#7f7f7f", edgecolor="k", linewidth=.5)
ax.axvline(0.464, color="#d62728", lw=2, label="human AP3D1 1-14 (0.464)")
ax.axvline(0.210, color="k", lw=1.5, ls="--", label="human proteome median (0.210)")
ax.set_xlabel("hydrophobic moment of residues 1-14")
ax.set_ylabel("number of species")
ax.set_title("The amphipathic character is fixed across vertebrates")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
